mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mcp_servers WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM mcp_servers WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_servers (project_id, name, endpoint, scope, auth_mode) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{name}, #{endpoint}, #{scope}, #{authMode})
mapper.update: UPDATE mcp_servers SET name = #{name}, enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE mcp_servers SET oauth_client = #{client} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mcp_credentials WHERE server_id = #{serverId} AND owner_slot = COALESCE(#{owner,jdbcType=BIGINT}, 0) FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM mcp_credentials WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_credentials (server_id, owner_user_id) VALUES (#{serverId}, #{owner,jdbcType=BIGINT}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE server_id = mcp_credentials.server_id
mapper.update: UPDATE mcp_credentials SET access_token = #{access,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, refresh_token = #{refresh,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, expires_at = #{expiry,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP,typeHandler=qg.qgent.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler}, reauth_required = FALSE, revision = revision + CASE WHEN #{replace} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE mcp_credentials SET access_token = NULL, refresh_token = NULL, expires_at = NULL, reauth_required = TRUE, revision = revision + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT agent_id FROM mcp_agent_assignments WHERE credential_id = #{credentialId} ORDER BY agent_id

SELECT s.* FROM mcp_servers s JOIN mcp_credentials c ON c.server_id = s.id AND c.owner_slot = CASE WHEN s.scope = 'PERSONAL' THEN #{actor} ELSE 0 END JOIN mcp_agent_assignments a ON a.credential_id = c.id AND a.agent_id = #{agentId} WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND s.enabled ORDER BY s.id
